reason: I'd install it because DDS/EXR/TGA and FBX/GLB in one viewer would save me opening the engine, but my current viewer is fine for everyday pictures and I won't re-learn shortcuts and re-tick file associations for it. Default stays where it is.
why_switch_or_not: The pull is the game-project stuff: textures, HDR, alpha PSD and a quick look at a model without launching anything, plus the Explorer Space-bar preview. Against that, it is 0.4.1 from one guy, I don't know if it handles my alpha/normal-map files right, and I'd have to set the defaults myself in Windows Settings. Speed claims don't move me much, my viewer is already instant on JPG/PNG.
current_app_pros: Tiny, opens instantly, I know every key by heart, never crashes, handles PNG/JPG/WebP and my day-to-day alpha PNGs fine.
current_app_pains: It can't open DDS, EXR or HDR properly and doesn't show 3D models or PSD with any accuracy, so for those I jump to other tools. Otherwise nothing really bugs me.
objection: Another image viewer from a single developer at 0.4.1: I don't want to relearn keys and move my associations for something that might be abandoned or show my textures with wrong colour or alpha.
would_change_my_mind: Proof that it opens my own DDS/EXR/TGA texture files with correct alpha and colour and shows channels, plus a few months of steady updates, would make it my default for those formats.
